description: RAG_EXPANDED_V2: the five prototype_v1 documents plus the first-wave expansion sources approved on 2026-10-25. Metadata is entered by hand from each document's own cover, letter date or release note; nothing is inferred from arbitrary page text. Temporal fields: publication_date (ISO, null if not printed), publication_year (null if the date is unknown), publication_date_review_flag, and for undated annual reports reporting_period and content_not_before (a dated event observed in the text: the document cannot have been published before it). These support future date-bounded retrieval (publication_date <= analysis_date); no time filtering is applied yet.
